p.d: Scheduled 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07 · 1) If unexpected asbestos containing materials are encountered, the work will immediately cease. The area will be misted with water, and the Asbestos Supervisor will notify the owner's and prime contractor's representatives for additional instructions. 2) The regulated asbestos containing material is primarily pipe insulation or other thermal system insulation. Piping consists of insulated piping and mudded elbows and associated fittings. Negative pressure containment and wet removal methods will be used for removal of TSI from piping and surface of a small tank. 3) To prevent migration of asbestos fibers from the work area, glove bags and negative pressure enclosures will be utilized. Poly containmnets will be constructed and poly sheeting will be use to wrap any remaining TSI on piping or small tank. Continuous negative pressure enclosures will be used during abatement activities, and clearance monitoring in the immediate work area will be performed following decontamination of enclosure. Waste will be double bagged, goose-necked, and labeled; the waste will be placed into a dedicated rolloff and manifested/transported to a permitted asbestos waste disposal site. · Facility Owner: NASA - Johnson Space Center
